title: Underwater Dredging Robot Navigation in Structured Environments Based on Imaging Sonar Features
authors: X. Tian; C. Zhang; M. Cong; D. Pan; D. Liu; Y. Du
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
